hints.title: Recursive Subsequence Construction
hints.text: Construct candidate sequences element by element, appending numbers that are greater than or equal to the previous selected value.

hints.title: Branch-Level Deduplication
hints.text: To avoid duplicate identical subsequences, track values already chosen at the current recursion level using a local collection.

hints.title: Backtracking with Local Choice Set
hints.text: At each recursive frame, maintain a set of used values for this branch. Iterate through remaining elements; if an element is greater than or equal to the last picked value and has not been used at this recursion depth, recurse with it included.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Generates all unique non-decreasing subsequences through branch-pruned backtracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting is disallowed because subsequence ordering must match original array order.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A local hash set per recursive level prunes duplicate values without global set lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle duplicates at the current search depth correctly without altering array order.
